PO.Data: Price based on a purchase order
The PO Price indicates the price for a product per the purchase order.

Step.SQLStatement: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW RV_ConsignementDetail AS SELECT po.C_Order_ID, pol.C_OrderLine_ID, po.C_Currency_ID, po.C_BPartner_ID AS DropShip_BPartner_ID, po.DateOrdered, pol.M_Product_ID, s.Line, s.C_Invoice_ID, s.C_InvoiceLine_ID, s.M_Inventory_ID, s.M_InventoryLine_ID, s.DocumentNo, s.C_BPartner_ID, s.DateDoc, s.C_DocType_ID, s.QtyUsed, s.ConsignementReturnQty, s.QtyToInvoice, s.IsAllocated, s.PriceLimit, s.PriceActual, s.LineNetAmt, s.SalesRep_ID, s.Link_OrderLine_ID, s.Description, po.AD_Client_ID, po.AD_Org_ID, po.IsActive, po.Created, po.CreatedBy, po.Updated, po.UpdatedBy, s.Link_Order_ID, pol.PriceActual AS PricePO FROM C_Order po INNER JOIN C_OrderLine pol ON(pol.C_Order_ID = po.C_Order_ID) INNER JOIN M_Product p ON(p.M_Product_ID = pol.M_Product_ID) INNER JOIN (SELECT il.M_Product_ID, il.Line, i.C_Invoice_ID, il.C_InvoiceLine_ID, NULL AS M_Inventory_ID, NULL AS M_InventoryLine_ID, i.DocumentNo, i.C_BPartner_ID, i.DateInvoiced AS DateDoc, i.C_DocType_ID, (CASE WHEN i.Multiplier > 0 THEN il.QtyInvoiced ELSE 0 END) AS QtyUsed, (CASE WHEN i.Multiplier < 0 THEN il.QtyInvoiced ELSE 0 END) AS ConsignementReturnQty, (il.QtyInvoiced * i.Multiplier) AS QtyToInvoice, (CASE WHEN iol.Link_OrderLine_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) IsAllocated, il.PriceLimit, il.PriceActual, il.LineNetAmt, i.SalesRep_ID, il.Description, iol.Link_OrderLine_ID, ior.C_Order_ID AS Link_Order_ID FROM RV_C_Invoice i INNER JOIN C_InvoiceLine il ON(il.C_Invoice_ID = i.C_Invoice_ID) INNER JOIN C_OrderLine iol ON(iol.C_OrderLine_ID = il.C_OrderLine_ID) LEFT JOIN C_OrderLine ior ON(ior.C_OrderLine_ID = iol.Link_OrderLine_ID) WHERE i.IsSOTrx = 'Y' AND i.DocStatus IN('CO', 'CL') UNION ALL SELECT il.M_Product_ID, il.Line, NULL AS C_Invoice_ID, NULL AS C_InvoiceLine_ID, i.M_Inventory_ID, il.M_InventoryLine_ID, i.DocumentNo, NULL AS C_BPartner_ID, i.MovementDate DateDoc, i.C_DocType_ID, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(il.QtyInternalUse, il.QtyCount, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(il.QtyInternalUse, il.QtyCount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS QtyUsed, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(il.QtyInternalUse, il.QtyCount, 0) < 0 THEN COALESCE(il.QtyInternalUse, il.QtyCount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS ConsignementReturnQty, COALESCE(il.QtyInternalUse, il.QtyCount, 0) AS QtyToInvoice, (CASE WHEN il.Link_OrderLine_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) IsAllocated, 0 AS PriceLimit, 0 AS PriceActual, 0 AS LineNetAmt, i.CreatedBy AS SalesRep_ID, il.Description, il.Link_OrderLine_ID, ior.C_Order_ID AS Link_Order_ID FROM M_Inventory i INNER JOIN M_InventoryLine il ON(il.M_Inventory_ID = i.M_Inventory_ID) INNER JOIN M_Product p ON(p.M_Product_ID = il.M_Product_ID) LEFT JOIN C_OrderLine ior ON(ior.C_OrderLine_ID = il.Link_OrderLine_ID) AND i.DocStatus IN('CO', 'CL')) s ON(s.M_Product_ID = pol.M_Product_ID) WHERE po.IsSOTrx = 'N' AND po.DocStatus IN('CO', 'CL') AND po.IsDropShip = 'Y' AND p.IsDropShip = 'Y' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM M_Product_PO pp WHERE pp.M_Product_ID = pol.M_Product_ID AND po.C_BPartner_ID = pp.C_BPartner_ID AND pp.IsActive = 'Y' AND pp.Discontinued = 'N')
